about: Where each boss model in public/models/bosses/ came from. Decide's 3D boss scene (src/platform/bosses/BossScene3D.tsx) draws them; the 2D cutouts in public/bosses/full/ are made from the same concepts, so both scenes show the same robots.
by: Orbit, in David's Tripo account; David named Tripo for these ("animated robots. Tripo", via Goldy)
credits: 285: five models at 45 and three rigs at 20 (8,190 -> 7,905). The concepts and preset animations were free.
processed: research/station-assets/process.mjs <exports> public/models/bosses 1024: color texture only, as 1024 px webp; static models baked, centered and resting on y = 0; rigged ones keep their skeleton and clips (resampled).

overall.name: The Station Administrator
overall.concept: research/station-assets/boss-figures/overall.jpg (the full-body concept in public/bosses/provenance.json "figures", made with the boss's portrait as the reference image)
overall.model: Tripo Studio image to 3D: HD Model, H3.1, 2K texture, triangles, 10,000 polygon target; task f815f35d-72bd-46d8-b62e-27a5ddb42fcc; 45 credits
overall.animations: none: not humanoid, so the scene moves it in code (a bob, and a lean when it talks)
